author: Coco_stag
body:
Alright! I know this will be impossible to convince the server to go fully back to prestige, but let's give this a go! I'm not saying make the whole server prestige but maybe the unused servers! I honestly think the credits system is a partially why some people left. This may introduce people to the other servers and may make smaller game modes like CTH, walls and nexus more played. The level system is way more fun then the credits system IMO. No, I am not just saying that because I was banned for 90% when the server had prestiges.

Oh, like always the prestige will only be shown on the specific server that you got it on.

So... FEEDBACK PLEASE

replies.author: MasterProX
replies.body: A month or so ago, during one of his development streams, I directly asked Kylo about the removal of badges in favor of prestiges, since the senior staff at the time — namely Iron and possibly a few others — had foreshadowed the return of the prestige system, long before the stream I mentioned. Kylo claimed to have never been informed at all about this, essentially stating that we'll be staying with badges because they're supposedly "better" or more entertaining than prestiges (which I disagree with), more preferred by the community (questionable), and because reimplementing prestiges would be a lot of work left entirely up to the developers, who wouldn't prioritize something so relatively insignificant when they can code bug fixes and new gamemodes instead.
